sources.publisher: South Carolina Department of Natural Resources public water access GIS
sources.interpretation: The active/open agency point is explicitly classified as a paddle launch/ramp on the Catawba River. The point is retained as the launch coordinate with 75-foot uncertainty; no separate field survey of the exact ramp toe was found.

sources.publisher: South Carolina Department of Natural Resources
facts: Rock Hill River Park has a carry-in boat launch with nearby parking.
The launch is at the mouth of Manchester Creek on the Catawba River.
The site is at the end of Quality Circle, off Red River Road.

sources.publisher: City of Rock Hill Parks, Recreation and Tourism
facts: The City lists a canoe/kayak launch at River Park.
The published address is 1782 Quality Circle, Rock Hill.
Seasonal park hours are published by the City.

imageryCheck: The SCDNR GIS feature is a managed launch point, not an imagery-derived coordinate. The post-edit audit's point-to-water and flowline distances will be used to verify its mapped placement; no shoreline point will be inferred from hydrography alone.
